kind.description: renamed: id in a is `to` in b; added: only in b; removed: only in a; config: both configs read and they behave the same (with reviewed_at); ignore: any difference of this id, a staging artefact

file.description: for a config entry: the file(s) under config_dir that define what it explains; reviewed_at is their last commit. Without it, an automation's file is found by its id, anything else binds to the whole config tree

reviewed_at.description: the commit the config entry was reviewed at (7 or more hex digits): the last commit of the files that define what it explains

after_restart.description: for `verify`: this entity may be `unknown` right after a restart (its value comes with the next event)
